ladder_description: The game's own quality steps for when it is overloaded: a shorter detail distance (LOD) and fewer sun shadow views. Draws per frame on our route: 5,180 at full quality, 4,456 at level 4, 3,747 at 8, 2,370 at 11, 1,070 at 15. Higher levels are faster and plainer.

mods.name: Scalability ladder level 4 (the game's own overload level: LOD 0.7, 3 sun shadow views)
mods.title: Level 4

mods.name: Scalability ladder level 8 (LOD 0.4, 3 sun shadow views)
mods.title: Level 8

mods.name: Scalability ladder level 11 (LOD 0.2, 2 sun shadow views)
mods.title: Level 11

mods.name: Scalability ladder level 15 (LOD 0.1, 1 sun shadow view - the lowest level the game uses)
mods.title: Level 15

mods.name: Render 1080p (dynamic-resolution index locked at 15 = 1920x1080, also in cutscenes)
mods.title: Render at 1080p
mods.gain: +21% fps in cutscenes, no gain on the route
mods.description: The game renders at 1920x1080, also in cutscenes, where it would go up to 3584x2016.

mods.name: LOD scale 0.4 in ladder row 0 (the same detail distance as level 8, kept when the game changes its ladder level)
mods.title: Shorter detail distance (LOD 0.4)
mods.description: Objects switch to simpler models closer to the camera. Unlike the ladder levels, it stays on for the whole session.

mods.name: Sun shadows: 3 views instead of 4 (one cascade less, as the game's own overload levels 4-8)
mods.title: Sun shadows: 3 views
mods.description: One sun shadow cascade less: distant shadows softer, water without shadows.

mods.name: Local light shadows: at most 2 spot-light shadow maps per frame (instead of 8)
mods.title: Lamp shadows: at most 2
mods.gain: not measured yet (all lamp shadows off: +4% fps)
mods.description: Lamps, fires and torches: at most 2 cast shadows at once (instead of 8).

mods.name: No particle shadows (Particle Finalize and particle draws skipped in shadow views; smoke/fire cast no shadow)
mods.title: No particle shadows
mods.description: Smoke, fire and mist cast no shadows.

mods.name: Mist and translucent particles always at 1/4 resolution (the game's own lowest level)
mods.title: Mist at 1/4 resolution
mods.description: Mist and see-through particles always at the game's lowest resolution (softer mist).

mods.name: No grass in shadow views (the call of the grass pass in the shadow-view builder left out)
mods.title: No grass shadows

mods.name: Actors (people, animals) LOD scale fixed at 0.5 (shorter detail/draw distance for actors)
mods.title: Shorter detail for people and animals
mods.description: People and animals switch to simpler models closer to the camera.

mods.name: Small shadow casters culled (ladder row 0 small-caster cull 0 -> 0.05)
mods.title: Small shadow casters culled
mods.description: Very small objects cast no shadows.

mods.name: No particle simulation (the particle compute shaders - emit, update, finalize - skipped by the emulator)
mods.title: No particles
mods.description: Smoke, mist, wind waves, sparks and leaves disappear (emulator setting, no game memory change).
